title: Apple Display Coprocessor Panel Pixel Compensation (PPC) Specification

bics.name: Burn-In Compensation System (BICS)
bics.target: Tandem OLED differential subpixel degradation mitigation
bics.aging_formula: Cumulative subpixel stress: S(x, y, c) = sum(Luminance(x, y, c)^gamma * dt * exp(-E_a / (k_B * T)))
bics.gain_correction: Applies real-time per-subpixel voltage offset to worn pixels, restoring uniform luminance and chromaticity across the panel lifetime.

ptuc.name: Panel Temperature Uniformity Compensation (PTUC)
ptuc.target: Temperature gradient compensation across SoC and battery regions
ptuc.fallback_temperature_policy: If SMC 2D temperature is unread, fallback to PMU temperature as initial_guess.

lut_architecture.name: 2DTC LUT (2D Temperature Compensation)
lut_architecture.interpolation: Bilinear spatial interpolation combined with piecewise-linear temperature/brightness evaluation.

ptuc.compensation_action: Modulates subpixel drive currents to prevent localized thermal discoloration over hot SoC components.

pdc.name: Pixel Distortion & Density Compensation (PDC)
pdc.target: Dynamic Island subpixel geometric distortion correction & corner curvature feathering
features: Anti-aliased border feathering around sensor cutouts (Dynamic Island)
Curved display corner subpixel luminance smoothing
Subpixel Uniformity Compensation (SPUC) per-panel factory calibration map
Mix bin blending: mix bin g1 and bin g2 with weight w -> g_out

acss.name: Active / Angle Color Shift (ACSS)
acss.target: Off-axis OLED viewing angle color shift mitigation
acss.ambient_adaptation: ACSS_ALS_RESCALE: Rescales EMMP matrix based on multi-channel ambient light sensor lux and CCT.
acss.viewing_angle_compensation: Compensates for blue/yellow chromaticity drift at viewing angles > 30 degrees by dynamic micro-cavity optical resonance tuning.
